title: Grave Robber
summary: Browser sandbox pairing a 2D catacomb explorer with a crypt-riddle ledger. November 5 review: the public page loads with a demo address, four sample crypts and a simulated balance; the Crypt Ledger and privacy explanation remain reachable. MIT source revision a20bccb is unchanged with no published releases. Creator documentation describes a separate Sapient wallet flow, but this review did not connect a wallet, create a crypt or claim a bounty. The retained October recording demonstrates the sandbox only. The original Reddit announcement remains removed by Reddit filters; its permalink, creator forum submissions and earlier evidence are preserved.
cardSummary: Explore candlelit catacombs and inspect crypt riddles in a browser sandbox with a simulated bounty ledger.
